directory.name: BoBu
directory.style: Pizza, calzones and pretzels from a walk-up/drive-thru shipping-container stand
directory.note: Walk-up and drive-thru pizza, calzone and pretzel stand in a converted shipping container, opened by Florin Bucur and Nick Bodea in April 2025.

directory.name: Sunny Hill
directory.note: Long-running neighborhood pizzeria from the Stoneburner restaurant group, serving Detroit-style squares and round pies alongside burgers and brunch since 2020.
